label: Figure 11.5: The movement from short-run abnormal profit to long-run normal profit
alt: Abnormal profit attracts entry: industry supply shifts right from S to S1, price falls from P to P1, and each firm's demand line falls until it touches the minimum of AC at output q1, where price equals average cost.
caption: In the short run the firm earns the shaded abnormal profit at price P and output q. Profit attracts new firms, so industry supply shifts right from S to S<sub>1</sub>, lowering the price to P<sub>1</sub> and raising industry output to Q<sub>1</sub>. The firm’s demand line falls to D<sub>1</sub> = AR<sub>1</sub> = MR<sub>1</sub>, which just touches the bottom of AC where MC = MR at q<sub>1</sub>; P<sub>1</sub> = C<sub>1</sub> and only normal profit remains.
